A [[Species/Legends|species]] of '''fowl''' lived on<ref name="CWA" /> [[Garqi/Legends|Garqi]],<ref name="Order 66" /> an [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] located in the [[Cassander sector/Legends|Cassander sector]].<ref name="Geo">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> The [[Bird/Legends|fowl]] had a small body, with a tail several times its length. This was divided into three, circular-tipped, central tail feathers. The bird had two, long [[Limb/Legends|wings]], each terminating in two-digit, bald, [[Color/Legends|pink]] claws. The body, wings, and tail were all covered in pink plumage. The species had a small, bald head, with a pink comb between its [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. These eyes had a white sclera and black pupil, and were placed one on each side of the head. The species' beak was pink and ridged, and had an overhanging maxilla.<ref name="CWA" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{CWACite|4|Orders (comic story)}} depicts [[Order 66]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]</ref> four birds of this species were disturbed from [[Grass/Legends|grasslands]] when the [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]] [[Evan]] ran away from the [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] of [[Aiwha Squad]] shortly after the conclusion of the [[Battle of Garqi (Clone Wars)|Battle of Garqi]]. The fowls scattered in different directions, with one shedding several feathers as it flew away.<ref name="CWA" />

==Behind the scenes==
This species of fowl appeared in "[[Orders (comic story)|Orders]]," a [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] published in ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume 4]]''<ref name="CWA" /> on [[October 26]], [[2005]]<ref name="DH-Link">{{DarkHorse|url=Books/10-920/Star-Wars-Clone-Wars-Adventures-Vol-4-TPB|text=Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Vol. 4 TPB}}</ref> "Orders" was written by [[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]], penciled by [[Rick Lacy]] and colored by [[Ronda Pattison]].<ref name="CWA" />
